title.narrative: Integrated Approach to Stability in Mali through improved access to justice and security and community recovery

description.narrative:
The project aims to address the lack of trust in state institutions and justice systems and lack of social cohesion through targeted interventions towards victims of violent extremism and towards public services. Local counterparts include a diverse number of national agents and units working on counterterrorism and organised crime, investigation, and prevention of violent extremism.
At institutional level beneficiaries include justice and security actors, such as prosecutors, judges, law enforcement officers, but also police and gendarmerie. At the local and community level targeted groups include local governance structures and traditional and religious leaders. At the individual level, victims of violent extremism and terrorism as well as IDPs will be targeted. Women, youth and children will be prioritised.
Activities are divided between the three implementing organisations, UNODC (lead), IOM and UNDP.
